description: Shared chunk-level relevance judgments for evaluating retrieval across LlamaIndex, Haystack, LangChain, and LlamaStack.

grading_scale.1: Partially relevant or provides useful supporting context.
grading_scale.2: Directly answers or substantially supports the question.

metrics.mrr_at_k: Rank of the first chunk with grade >= 1.
metrics.recall_at_k: Deferred until the complete relevant chunk set is established for each question.
metrics.framework_native_scores: Diagnostic only; do not compare raw scores across frameworks.
